div.h1: PR #3 - falling item lifecycle: pooled, never destroyed
div.p: One FallingItem object per visible sprite, reused forever. Heap snapshots: 4 instances after 30 s and after 60 s.

text.tspan: RULE: objects that appear and disappear in a loop are recycled, not destroyed.
reset() overwrites everything update() changes, so a recycled item carries no old state.
Removal walks the array backwards and swaps with the last element.
(dt capped at 0.1 s by the ticker, so at most one spawn per frame)
for index from active.length - 1 down to 0
